title: Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows
title_zh: Argo-Bench：在企业级工作流上评估数据智能体

paragraphs.en: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator’s ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界中的企业数据科学和分析工作流程需要跨越数十张表进行推理、执行统计分析，并根据结果采取行动。 现有的文本转 SQL 基准测试仅评估查询生成能力，而审计发现其答案键经常存在错误。 由于真实的企业数据仓库过于敏感而无法公开，这些基准测试基于公共数据集构建，其中每个商业事件都仅包含在一张表中。 我们提出了 Argo-Bench，一个包含 210 个数据科学和分析任务的评估框架。 我们借助公共数据、经过同行评审的行业文献以及监管文件，模拟了一个真实规模的新 York City 食品配送平台，该平台在 2024 年拥有 8100 万笔订单，并具备真实的经济模型、欺诈模式和市场激励机制。 我们将这一世界导出到一个包含 235 张表和 75 亿行数据的 ERP 仓库中，其模型基于 Oracle E-Business Suite 的架构。 模拟器的真实状态并未提供给智能体所看到的数据仓库，因此任务要求智能体在采取行动前，通过遍历仓库来重建事实。 Argo-Bench 超越了文本转 SQL 的范畴：智能体可以执行诸如封禁欺诈账户、分配快递员激励预算或发放补发工资等操作，评分器则根据这些操作在模拟器中产生的后果进行打分。 每个任务都提供一个可执行的参考解决方案，该方案仅使用仓库数据即可证明问题具有可解性。 在 14 个前沿和开放权重模型中，表现最强的模型也仅在 34.8% 的任务上获得了 95 分或更高的分数，平均得分为 59.5 分。 我们希望 Argo-Bench 能够推动智能体朝着理解、导航并能在真实数据环境中行动的方向发展。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, data agents have advanced from answering simple text-to-SQL questions over small, well-documented schemas to performing long-horizon data science tasks, publishing durable company-wide assets such as dashboards, and acting on their findings, for instance, by adjusting promotions and banning fraudulent accounts ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Rising scores on established data benchmarks could be read as a sign that enterprise data work is close to solved. The best Spider 2.0-Snow score has risen from 23.8% at release ( Lei et al., 2025 ) to 96.7%, and the top BIRD entry reaches 82.4% against a human 93.0%. 1 1 1 Spider 2.0 leaderboard: https://spider2-sql.github.io/ ; BIRD leaderboard: https://bird-bench.github.io/ ; both accessed September 24, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，数据智能体已从在结构清晰、文档齐全的小型模式上回答简单的文本转 SQL 问题，发展到能够执行长期数据科学任务、发布持久性的全公司资产（如仪表板），并根据其发现采取行动，例如调整促销策略和封禁欺诈账户（Sun et al., 2025；Liu et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026）。 在现有数据基准测试中得分的提升，可能被解读为企业数据处理工作已接近解决的迹象。 Spider 2.0-Snow 的最佳得分已从发布时的 23.8%（Lei et al., 2025）提升至 96.7%，而 BIRD 的最高得分则达到了 82.4%，与人类的 93.0% 相比仍有差距。1 1 1 Spider 2.0 排行榜：https://spider2-sql.github.io/；BIRD 排行榜：https://bird-bench.github.io/；两者均于 2026 年 9 月 24 日访问。

paragraphs.en: However, current benchmarks primarily evaluate text-to-SQL performance and are not representative of enterprise agentic data workflows in three important ways. First, they run on a patchwork of public data. Spider 2.0-Snow’s 547 questions sparsely cover a sprawling collection of 152 databases (Appendix H ). Over a third of those databases are used for a single question only. Two thirds of the questions use BigQuery public datasets; another quarter use local sample databases ( Lei et al., 2025 ) . These public and local sources’ schemas are documented in tutorials and textbooks. Furthermore, there is a high degree of overlap among tables: at least two thirds of the tables are date-, geography-, or version-sharded copies of another table. In an enterprise warehouse, different modules must agree on the same numbers, and one business event may touch ten or more tables ( Plattner, 2014 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当前的基准测试主要评估文本转 SQL 的性能，并且在三个重要方面无法代表企业智能体数据工作流。 首先，这些测试运行在零散拼凑的公开数据上。 Spider 2.0-Snow 的 547 个问题仅稀疏地覆盖了 152 个数据库的庞大集合（附录 H）。 其中超过三分之一的数据库仅用于单个问题。 三分之二的問題使用 BigQuery 公开数据集；另有四分之一使用本地样本数据库（Lei et al., 2025）。 这些公开和本地数据源的 schema 在教程和教科书中都有记录。 此外，表之间存在高度重叠：至少三分之二的表是其他表按日期、地理位置或版本分片后的副本。 在企业数据仓库中，不同模块必须对同一组数字达成一致，而一个业务事件可能涉及十张或更多表（Plattner, 2014）。

paragraphs.en: Second, they are not end-to-end. Many of the most valuable enterprise data science tasks cannot be done in SQL. Fitting a demand forecast, training a fraud model, or optimizing a courier schedule requires statistical, machine learning, and optimization libraries. Additionally, findings lead to decisions, which are ultimately judged by their return on investment. For instance, a promotion with a high redemption rate can still lose money if most of those orders would have been placed anyway ( Xu et al., 2025b ) . A gold answer cannot distinguish between such decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，它们并非端到端的。 许多最具价值的企业数据科学任务无法通过 SQL 完成。 拟合需求预测、训练欺诈检测模型或优化快递员调度方案都需要统计、机器学习和优化库的支持。 此外，研究结果会引导决策，而这些决策最终将依据其投资回报率受到评判。 例如，即使某项促销活动的兑换率很高，但如果大多数订单原本无论如何都会产生，这项活动仍然可能亏损（Xu et al., 2025b）。 标准答案无法区分这类决策之间的差异。

sents.en: Second, they are not end-to-end.
sents.zh: 其次，它们并非端到端的。

paragraphs.en: Third, they are not verifiable. On real data, a benchmark can only measure agreement with its annotators since writing the answer key requires solving the task. Even when the answer is in the data, annotators may miss it. In a recent audit, 62.8% of Spider 2.0-Snow’s released gold queries and 52.8% of BIRD Mini-Dev’s were found to be erroneous, most often because annotators misread the data or the schema, and correcting BIRD’s errors moved agents’ leaderboard standings by up to nine places ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . Furthermore, for many of the most valuable enterprise tasks, the answer may not be in the data at all. Fraud left undetected leaves no label ( Altman et al., 2023 ) , and the outcomes of a rejected decision are never observed.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，它们无法被验证。 在真实数据中，基准测试只能衡量模型与标注者之间的一致性，因为编写答案键本身就需要完成任务。 即使答案存在于数据中，标注者也可能错过它。 在最近的一次审计中，发现 Spider 2.0-Snow 发布的黄金查询中有 62.8% 存在错误，BIRD Mini-Dev 的黄金查询中则有 52.8% 存在错误；这些错误大多源于标注者误读了数据或模式，而修正 BIRD 中的错误可使智能体在排行榜上的排名提升多达九位（Jin et al., 2026）。 此外，对于许多最具价值的企业任务而言，答案可能根本不在数据中。 未被发现的欺诈行为不会留下任何标签（Altman et al., 2023），而被拒绝的决策所带来的结果也永远无法被观察到。

sents.zh: 第三，它们无法被验证。

paragraphs.en: Large enterprises keep the records that financial planning, forecasting, and fraud detection require in enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems ( Davenport, 1998 ) such as Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), SAP S/4HANA, and Oracle Fusion Cloud, extended with custom tables representing idiosyncrasies and workflows unique to the business ( Brehm et al., 2001 ) . Because the same systems hold the company’s ledgers, payroll, and customer records, access to them is heavily restricted. For this reason, ERP data has remained practically unexplored in benchmarks to date. When such data is released, it must be anonymized, which can break the relational structure that answers depend on. In an early release of BEAVER ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , the closest attempt to date, Chung et al. (2025) report primary keys that violate their uniqueness constraints and questions whose gold query is null.
paragraphs.zh: 大型企业将财务规划、预测和欺诈检测所需的记录保存在企业资源规划（ERP）系统（Davenport，1998）中，例如 Oracle E-Business Suite（EBS）、SAP S/4HANA 和 Oracle Fusion Cloud，这些系统还通过自定义表格扩展，以表示企业特有的独特属性和工作流程（Brehm 等，2001）。 由于同一套系统也存储了公司的账簿、薪资记录和客户信息，因此对这些系统的访问受到严格限制。 正因如此，迄今为止，ERP 数据在基准测试中几乎未被探索。 当这类数据被发布时，必须经过匿名化处理，而这可能会破坏答案所依赖的关系结构。 在 BEAVER 的一个早期版本（Chen 等，2024）中，这是迄今为止最接近的尝试，Chung 等 （2025）报告称，其中存在违反唯一性约束的主键，以及其标准查询为 null 的问题。

paragraphs.en: We instead simulate a business and grade against the simulation’s ground truth (Figure 1 ). Argo-Bench models a food delivery platform in New York City in 2024, a three-sided marketplace whose economics are disclosed to the city every month ( 49 ) . The simulator reflects a real minimum-pay increase in April 2024 ( 50 ) , and is calibrated to these disclosures and to public filings. None of its data is generated by a language model. We project this world into an Oracle EBS warehouse that omits the simulator’s latent state, so tasks are harder to solve than to verify ( Song et al., 2025 ) . The agent must reconstruct facts from the warehouse, while the grader reads them off the state. Agents work in a sandboxed Python environment with statistics, machine-learning, and optimization libraries (Appendix F ), and file their decisions and results through a mission-control interface rather than returning a query. Because the grader knows the latent state, it can grade a decision by its consequences. For instance, a list of banned accounts is scored by the fraud losses it prevents, including losses from fraud that the platform never detected, net of the revenue lost from wrongly banned customers.

paragraphs.en: Simulated environments are an established practice in a broad range of domains ( Altman et al., 2023 ; Lopez-Rojas et al., 2016 ; Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , and synthetic warehouses have long been used to benchmark data systems ( Nambiar & Poess, 2006 ; Ghazal et al., 2013 ) . Even Spider 2.0 draws a fifth of its questions from synthetic, obfuscated, or textbook sample schemas (Appendix H ). To our knowledge, no prior simulated benchmark combines an enterprise-scale warehouse whose tables must agree with one another and a grader that scores the consequences of the agent’s actions against the simulator’s latent state.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟环境已在广泛领域中得到广泛应用（Altman 等人，2023；Lopez-Rojas 等人，2016；Trivedi 等人，2024；Barres 等人，2025；Xu 等人，2025a；Huang 等人，2026），而合成仓库长期以来一直被用于对数据系统进行比较评估（Nambiar & Poess，2006；Ghazal 等人，2013）。 即使是 Spider 2.0，其五分之一的提问也来自合成、模糊化或教科书中的示例模式（附录 H）。 据我们所知，此前没有任何模拟基准同时结合了企业级仓库——其表结构必须相互一致——以及一个能够根据智能体行为在模拟器中的潜在状态对其后果进行评分的评估器。

paragraphs.en: A synthetic, large-scale public ERP dataset in Oracle EBS format for a 2024 New York City food delivery platform, comprising 235 mutually constraining tables, 81 million orders, 3.4 million active customers, and 7.5 billion rows, in which an order resolves into dispatch decisions, courier pay, merchant payouts, and balanced general-ledger journals.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个合成的大规模公共 ERP 数据集，采用 Oracle EBS 格式，用于描述一个 2024 年的纽约市食品配送平台。该数据集包含 235 个相互约束的表、8100 万份订单、340 万活跃客户以及 75 亿行数据；其中，每份订单都会分解为派单决策、快递员薪酬、商家结算以及平衡后的总账分录。

paragraphs.en: A grader that scores the consequences of an action rather than the correctness of a query, using the simulator’s latent state as ground truth, for instance, to score bans by the fraud losses they prevent and forecasts against held-out months, supporting tasks across fraud detection, forecasting, and financial planning.
paragraphs.zh: 一种评分器，它根据行动的后果而非查询的正确性进行评分，并利用模拟器的潜在状态作为基准事实。例如，它可以通过欺诈行为所避免的损失以及预测与预留月份之间的对比来对禁令进行评分，从而支持欺诈检测、预测和财务规划等多项任务。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark of 210 such tasks, from publishing a dashboard data source to fitting forecasts and banning fraudulent accounts, with an evaluation of 14 frontier and open-weight models.
paragraphs.zh: 一项包含 210 项此类任务的基准测试，任务范围涵盖发布仪表板数据源、拟合预测模型到封禁欺诈账户等，并对 14 个前沿及开放权重模型进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: We simulate a food delivery platform in New York City (NYC) in 2024, similar to DoorDash, Grubhub, or Uber Eats. Public data on such platforms is aggregate. The city’s quarterly reports and the platforms’ own filings give totals, but order-level records cannot be released without exposing the platform’s customers, couriers, and margins. The world is therefore built from 34 public datasets and reports, each lending one mechanism (Appendix A ). Uber and Lyft trips, for instance, give the time to drive between two zones at a given hour, and MenuStat the menus for restaurant chains. Donors play one of three roles. Identity donors are public records of real entities in the city, such as its 45,834 restaurants, 1.07 million addresses, and 260 taxi zones, and enter the world as they are, except that the released warehouse renames some restaurants (see the ethics statement). Shape donors are measured elsewhere, on other people, in another city, or in another year, and lend the world only a distribution. Anchors are published totals that the world is calibrated to reproduce but never samples records from.
paragraphs.zh: 我们模拟了2024年纽约市（NYC）的一个食品配送平台，类似于DoorDash、Grubhub或Uber Eats。 此类平台的公开数据是汇总数据。 该市的季度报告以及平台自身的文件披露了总数，但订单级别的记录无法发布，否则将暴露平台的客户、骑手和利润空间。 因此，这个世界由34个公共数据集和报告构建而成，每个数据集或报告贡献了一种机制（附录A）。 例如，Uber和Lyft的行程数据提供了在特定小时内两个区域之间的驾驶时间，而MenuStat则提供了连锁餐厅的菜单。 捐赠者扮演三种角色之一。 身份捐赠者是该市真实实体的公开记录，例如45,834家餐厅、107万个地址和260个出租车区域，它们以原始状态进入这个世界，但发布的仓库对部分餐厅进行了重命名（参见伦理声明）。 形态捐赠者的数据是在其他地方、其他人群、另一座城市或另一年份中测量的，它们仅向这个世界贡献一种分布。 锚点则是已公布的总数，世界模型需要校准以重现这些总数，但绝不会从中采样记录。

paragraphs.en: We chose food delivery in NYC because its economics are unusually well documented. Delivery apps must report their monthly orders, consumer spending, merchant fees, courier earnings, productivity, and hours worked to the NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP), which publishes them quarterly ( 49 ) , and the 10-K filings of DoorDash and Grubhub give the shape of a platform’s balance sheet ( DoorDash, Inc., 2024b ; DoorDash, Inc., 2025 ; Grubhub Inc., 2021 ) . Following Walonoski et al. (2018) , we calibrate the world to these anchors, sized as a dominant platform. The result has 81 million orders, about 55% of the 148 million deliveries that apps reported to the DCWP for 2024, and 3.4 million active customers, and it must balance incentives on three sides: quests and suggested pay for couriers, promotions and surge pricing for customers, and co-funded campaigns for merchants. Its per-delivery economics stay within 5% of the DCWP’s figures in 13 of 16 quarterly comparisons (Figure 2 a).
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择纽约市的外卖行业，因为其经济数据得到了异常详尽的记录。外卖应用必须向纽约市消费者与工人保护局（DCWP）报告每月的订单量、消费者支出、商家费用、配送员收入、生产力以及工作时长，而该机构会每季度公布这些数据（49）。此外，DoorDash 和 Grubhub 的 10-K 年报也揭示了一个平台的大致资产负债表结构（DoorDash, Inc., 2024b；DoorDash, Inc., 2025；Grubhub Inc., 2021）。遵循 Walonoski 等人（2018）的研究方法，我们以这些数据为基准对模型世界进行校准，并将其设定为一个主导性平台。最终模型包含 8100 万笔订单，约占应用向 DCWP 报告的 2024 年 1.48 亿次配送量的 55%，以及 340 万活跃用户。该模型必须在三个层面平衡激励措施：为配送员提供任务和建议报酬、为顾客提供促销活动和溢价定价，以及为商家提供共同出资的推广活动。在 16 次季度对比中，其每次配送的经济效益与 DCWP 公布的数据差异保持在 5% 以内（图 2a）。

paragraphs.en: We selected 2024 because it contains a real extrinsic shock to these economics. NYC began enforcing a minimum pay rate of $17.96 per hour before tips for app-based restaurant delivery workers in December 2023 and raised it to $19.56 on April 1, 2024 ( 50 ) . We model the platforms’ response with a new courier scheduler that activates on that date, after which courier pay runs 6–9% above the anchor (Figure 2 a). The levers our platform uses may differ from those of the real platforms, but the aggregate effect is the same in direction and, to within 9%, in size, and because the world absorbs the same shock, we can ask realistic forecasting questions about it (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了 2024 年，因为这一年对这些经济体系造成了一个真实的外部冲击。 纽约市于 2023 年 12 月开始对基于应用程序的餐厅配送员执行每小时 17.96 美元的最低报酬标准（不含小费），并于 2024 年 4 月 1 日将其提高至 19.56 美元（50）。 我们通过一个在该日期生效的新快递员调度模型来模拟平台的响应，此后快递员的报酬将比基准水平高出 6%–9%（图 2a）。 我们平台使用的调节手段可能与实际平台不同，但其总体影响在方向上相同，在幅度上也在 9% 的误差范围内一致；而且由于世界承受了相同的冲击，我们可以据此提出关于该冲击的现实预测问题（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, we insert fraud patterns that public evidence shows are major problems for delivery platforms. Couriers steal orders after pickup ( Al Jazeera, 2025 ) , spoof their GPS ( Incognia, 2022 ) , grab offers with bots ( Chapman & Mehrotra, 2020 ) , or rent out their accounts ( DoorDash, Inc., 2024a ) . On the customer side, rings of new accounts farm promotions ( DoorDash, Inc., 2025 ; Incognia, 2025 ) , and stolen cards fund account takeovers and bust-outs ( DoorDash, Inc., 2025 ; Whittaker, 2018 ) . Storefronts may be shells ( Heier, 2023 ) or collude with couriers or regular customers on refunds ( DoorDash, Inc., 2023 ) , and their payouts can be diverted to changed bank accounts ( Maycock, 2024 ) . Each pattern is calibrated both to how separable real card fraud is and to how often honest customers share a device, an address, or a card, since the latter sets a detector’s precision (Appendix A ). The simulator generates the world from the donors, calibrates it to the anchors, inserts the fraud, and projects the result to the EBS format (Section 2.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Every standard table and column in our warehouse exists in the data dictionary of Oracle’s EBS 12.2 Vision instance, the demo environment Oracle provides as a reference. Our tables, however, carry on average 52% of the columns of their Vision counterparts. EBS serves every industry, and analytics exports omit the columns a business does not use, here unused flexfields (a third of the omitted columns) and features such as shipping, inventory, foreign currency, and withholding tax. These columns would be empty in this business’s data, so no task loses information by their omission.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仓库中的每张标准表和每个标准列都存在于 Oracle EBS 12.2 Vision 实例的数据字典中，而该演示环境是 Oracle 提供的参考环境。 然而，我们的表平均只包含其 Vision 对应表中 52% 的列。 EBS 服务于各行各业，分析导出会省略企业不使用的列，此处包括未使用的灵活域（占被省略列的三分之一）以及运输、库存、外币和代扣税等功能。 这些列在该企业的数据中为空值，因此省略它们不会导致任何任务丢失信息。

paragraphs.en: The warehouse does not contain data drift or inconsistencies, such as deprecated tables that overlap active ones or figures that fail to reconcile across tables. These inconsistencies sometimes accumulate in real data warehouses over years of migrations and acquisitions ( Vogelsgesang et al., 2018 ) . Though the consultants named this the most significant difference from their customers’ systems, we deliberately chose to keep this discrepancy. By doing so, we keep the ground truth unambiguous: if a legacy table were to disagree with an active one, the correct answer would depend on undocumented conventions. Mature warehouses compensate for their idiosyncrasies with semantic layers, data models, and institutional knowledge ( Kandel et al., 2012 ) . While we could provide such a layer alongside a more realistic messy warehouse, this would shift the evaluation’s focus to testing an ability to use a curated layer. We instead aim to test an understanding of enterprise data organization: production workloads reuse only a few dozen combinations of hundreds of tables ( van Renen et al., 2024 ) , and an agent new to a warehouse must discover which ones matter by deciding what and how much of the warehouse to explore. A greenfield warehouse isolates this skill of understanding and exploring enterprise data organization.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据仓库不存在数据漂移或不一致性问题，例如已弃用的表与活跃表重叠，或不同表中的数值无法对得上。 这些不一致性有时会在真实的数据仓库中，经过多年的迁移和收购而逐渐积累（Vogelsgesang 等，2018）。 尽管顾问们称这是与客户系统相比最显著的不同之处，但我们刻意选择保留这种差异。 通过这样做，我们确保了基准事实的明确性：如果某个旧表与活跃表存在冲突，正确答案将取决于未记录的行业惯例。 成熟的数据仓库通过语义层、数据模型和机构知识来弥补其自身特性带来的问题（Kandel 等，2012）。 虽然我们可以为更贴近现实、杂乱无章的数据仓库提供这样的语义层，但这会将评估的重点转移到测试使用精心整理语义层的能力上。 我们反而希望测试对大型企业数据组织结构的理解：实际生产任务仅会重复使用数百张表中的几十种组合（van Renen 等，2024），而初次接触该仓库的智能体必须通过决定探索哪些内容以及探索多少，来发现哪些表是关键。 一个从零开始构建的数据仓库能够独立检验这种理解并探索大型企业数据结构的能力。

paragraphs.en: Argo-Bench contains 210 tasks in five business areas (Figure 3 a). Trust and safety tasks are enforcement, where the agent finds fraud and abuse and acts on the accounts involved. FP&A tasks forecast unit economics and rebuild finance dashboards, marketplace tasks forecast courier supply and allocate budgets such as courier bonuses, accounting tasks report final values after the fact, and growth tasks measure, forecast, and publish the results of promotions and memberships.
paragraphs.zh: Argo-Bench 包含五个业务领域的 210 项任务（图 3a）。 信任与安全任务属于执行类任务，智能体需要发现欺诈和滥用行为，并对相关账户采取行动。 FP&A 任务负责预测单位经济模型并重建财务仪表板，市场任务负责预测快递员供应情况并分配预算（如快递员奖金），会计任务负责事后报告最终数值，而增长任务则负责衡量、预测并发布促销活动和会员计划的成果。

paragraphs.en: Each task has four parts (Appendix G ). The prompt states the problem as a stakeholder would. The scope sets the last month of 2024 visible to the agent. The expectations list the filings the grader requires, each with its action, keys, and grading mode. The answer key is frozen before any run and comes from SQL over the latent tables or from the simulator’s own labels, such as which couriers stole orders. Because the world is simulated, these labels are exact and need no anonymization ( Gadotti et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务包含四个部分（附录 G）。 提示词以利益相关者的视角陈述问题。 范围设定为智能体可见的 2024 年最后一个月。 期望部分列出了评分者所需的文件，每个文件都注明了操作、键和评分模式。 答案库在任何运行前都已固定，其数据来自对潜在表的 SQL 查询，或来自模拟器的自身标签，例如哪些快递员偷窃了订单。 由于世界是模拟的，这些标签是精确的，无需匿名化处理（Gadotti 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Prompts cover a range of writing styles and levels of detail. Some reference the grading criteria or the exact output expected, while others are more subtle. This reflects how real users pose data questions: loosely, as high-level business questions, and in no set style or template ( Kandel et al., 2012 ) . It also tests the skill of exploring data organization, since a less detailed prompt leaves the agent to discover which tables and conventions the question depends on. Several scenarios come in variants that differ only in such detail, and Appendix I compares them.
paragraphs.zh: 提示涵盖了多种写作风格和细节程度。 有些提示会引用评分标准或预期的具体输出，而另一些则更为隐晦。 这反映了真实用户提出数据问题的方式：较为随意，以高层级的业务问题形式提出，且没有固定的风格或模板（Kandel 等，2012）。 这也考验了探索数据组织结构的技能，因为提示越不详细，智能体就越需要自行发现问题所依赖的表格和惯例。 多个场景存在仅在这些细节上有所差异的不同变体，附录 I 对此进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Unlike most data science and analytics benchmarks, Argo-Bench does not ask agents to return a query. Agents file actions to a mission-control interface through a Python library in their sandbox (Appendix E ). This design has four advantages. First, it permits advanced data science tasks which require machine learning, operations research, and mathematical optimization libraries to complete. Second, it supports end-to-end workflows. Emitting the correct SQL is not enough in practice, as real tasks require taking actions, e.g., rebalancing courier incentives across zones and hours, banning a set of users who are likely committing fraud, or holding the payouts of a suspicious merchant. Third, filings are explicit declarations of intent. When benchmarks compare SQL results ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , it is hard to determine whether a close number is the agent’s answer or an intermediate result, whereas a filing states the value, interval, or reason the agent commits to, which also makes partial credit well defined. Fourth, grading is objective, unlike the LLM-as-a-judge evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) used in many related works.
paragraphs.zh: 与大多数数据科学和分析基准测试不同，Argo-Bench 不会要求智能体返回查询结果。 智能体通过其沙盒中的 Python 库（附录 E）向任务控制接口提交操作记录。 这种设计有四个优势。 首先，它允许需要机器学习、运筹学和数学优化库的高级数据科学任务得以完成。 其次，它支持端到端的工作流。 在实践中，仅输出正确的 SQL 是不够的，因为真实任务需要执行具体操作，例如在不同区域和时间段内重新平衡快递员激励措施，禁止可能实施欺诈的一组用户，或暂停对可疑商家的付款。 第三，操作记录是意图的明确声明。 当基准测试比较 SQL 结果时（Li et al., 2023；Lei et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2024），很难判断一个接近正确答案的数字究竟是智能体的最终答案还是中间结果，而操作记录则明确声明了智能体所承诺的值、区间或原因，这也使得部分得分的定义变得清晰。 第四，评分过程是客观的，这与许多相关研究中使用的“LLM 作为裁判”的评估方法（Zheng et al., 2023）不同。

sents.en: Unlike most data science and analytics benchmarks, Argo-Bench does not ask agents to return a query.
sents.zh: 与大多数数据科学和分析基准测试不同，Argo-Bench 不会要求智能体返回查询结果。

sents.en: Agents file actions to a mission-control interface through a Python library in their sandbox (Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 智能体通过其沙盒中的 Python 库（附录 E）向任务控制接口提交操作记录。

sents.en: This design has four advantages.
sents.zh: 这种设计有四个优势。

sents.en: First, it permits advanced data science tasks which require machine learning, operations research, and mathematical optimization libraries to complete.
sents.zh: 首先，它允许需要机器学习、运筹学和数学优化库的高级数据科学任务得以完成。

sents.en: Second, it supports end-to-end workflows.
sents.zh: 其次，它支持端到端的工作流。

sents.en: Emitting the correct SQL is not enough in practice, as real tasks require taking actions, e.g., rebalancing courier incentives across zones and hours, banning a set of users who are likely committing fraud, or holding the payouts of a suspicious merchant.
sents.zh: 在实践中，仅输出正确的 SQL 是不够的，因为真实任务需要执行具体操作，例如在不同区域和时间段内重新平衡快递员激励措施，禁止可能实施欺诈的一组用户，或暂停对可疑商家的付款。

sents.en: Third, filings are explicit declarations of intent.
sents.zh: 第三，操作记录是意图的明确声明。

sents.en: When benchmarks compare SQL results ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lei et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , it is hard to determine whether a close number is the agent’s answer or an intermediate result, whereas a filing states the value, interval, or reason the agent commits to, which also makes partial credit well defined.
sents.zh: 当基准测试比较 SQL 结果时（Li et al., 2023；Lei et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2024），很难判断一个接近正确答案的数字究竟是智能体的最终答案还是中间结果，而操作记录则明确声明了智能体所承诺的值、区间或原因，这也使得部分得分的定义变得清晰。

sents.en: Fourth, grading is objective, unlike the LLM-as-a-judge evaluation ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) used in many related works.
sents.zh: 第四，评分过程是客观的，这与许多相关研究中使用的“LLM 作为裁判”的评估方法（Zheng et al., 2023）不同。

paragraphs.en: Of the 210 tasks, 178 act on accounts, file a forecast, allocate a budget, or publish a dashboard data source, and 99 see only up to a cutoff month, as an analyst would at that date, so forecasts are graded on months the agent has not seen (Figure 3 ). Prompts average 159 words, 51 tasks require more than one filing, and the reference solution in Figure 1 joins six tables across three EBS modules to recover the minimum-pay rule and fit an interval. In size, Argo-Bench matches long-horizon agent benchmarks such as TheAgentCompany (175 tasks) ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , τ \tau -bench (165) ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , KramaBench (104) ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , and ELT-Bench (100) ( Jin et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在 210 项任务中，有 178 项涉及对账户采取行动、提交预测、分配预算或发布仪表板数据源；另有 99 项仅能看到截至某个截止月份的数据，这与分析师在该日期所能看到的信息一致，因此预测的评估基于智能体尚未看到的月份（图 3）。 提示词平均包含 159 个单词，有 51 项任务需要提交多次文件；而图 1 中的参考解决方案则通过连接三个 EBS 模块中的六个表，来恢复最低支付规则并确定一个区间。 在规模上，Argo-Bench 与长期智能体基准测试相当，例如 TheAgentCompany（175 项任务）（Xu et al., 2025a）、τ \tau -bench（165 项任务）（Yao et al., 2025）、KramaBench（104 项任务）（Lai et al., 2026）以及 ELT-Bench（100 项任务）（Jin et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Each expectation is scored from 0 to 100 (a forecast from − 200 -200 ) by one of nine grading modes (Appendix G ). Forecasts are scored by their weighted interval score ( Bracher et al., 2021 ) on a scale set by a reference forecast fixed before the outcome, so that filing one’s true median and interval is the best strategy, ban lists by the cost they save relative to banning nobody or everybody ( Elkan, 2001 ) , budget allocations by the share of the attainable savings that the simulator realizes, and data sources and reported figures by their values. A task’s score is the mean of its expectations’ scores, weighted as the task specifies. A run that files nothing where the key expects action scores zero on every expectation ( − 200 -200 on a forecast, the lowest a forecast can score).
paragraphs.zh: 每个期望值由九种评分模式之一（附录 G）进行评分，评分范围从 0 到 100（预测得分范围为 −200 至 −200）。 预测的评分基于其加权区间得分（Bracher et al., 2021），评分尺度由结果确定前固定的参考预测设定。因此，提交真实的中间值和区间是最佳策略；禁令列表的评分依据其相对于完全不实施禁令或全面实施禁令所节省的成本（Elkan, 2001）；预算分配则依据模拟器实现的可达节省额中所占的比例；数据源和报告数值的评分则依据其实际价值。 一项任务的得分是其所有期望值得分的平均值，具体权重由该任务的规定确定。 在关键步骤中未提交任何内容的运行，在每个期望值上的得分均为零（即预测得分 −200，这是预测可能获得的最低分数）。

paragraphs.en: We release the warehouse of one world on Hugging Face and keep a second, generated from a private seed, for official grading. We ran our experiments on BigQuery (941 GB uncompressed), and the released warehouse is a set of 1,219 Parquet files (76.5 GB), with a dataset card giving setup instructions for BigQuery, DuckDB, Snowflake, Trino, Delta Lake, and Iceberg. The two seeds share the simulator and its calibration, but every ID, customer, restaurant, and courier differs. 4 4 4 Because the economy depends on the seed, volumes also differ slightly. The public warehouse has 7.54 billion rows compared to the 7.49 billion in the private world described in this paper. Table 1 compares Argo-Bench with prior benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将一个世界的仓库发布到 Hugging Face，并保留另一个由私有种子生成的仓库用于官方评分。 我们在 BigQuery（941 GB 未压缩数据）上运行了实验，发布的仓库包含 1,219 个 Parquet 文件（76.5 GB），数据集卡片提供了 BigQuery、DuckDB、Snowflake、Trino、Delta Lake 和 Iceberg 的设置说明。 这两个种子共享模拟器和其校准参数，但每个 ID、客户、餐厅和快递员都不同。4 4 4 由于经济依赖于种子，数据量也存在细微差异。 公共仓库包含 75.4 亿行数据，而本文描述的私有世界则包含 74.9 亿行。 表 1 比较了 Argo-Bench 与先前的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: We run all experiments on Inspect AI 0.3.263 ( UK AI Security Institute, 2024 ) , an open-source evaluation framework, on Google Kubernetes Engine. Each agent works in its own gVisor ( Young et al., 2019 ) sandbox with 25 preinstalled Python libraries, an empty file system, and no outbound internet access, and files to its own mission-control instance through a Python library ( mission_control.py ) that emulates a company’s internal tooling. A run ends after 500 model turns, to stop models that loop without progress, and Appendix F lists the other limits. We evaluate models available in September 2026 across price ranges (Table 2 ), calling open-weight models through Fireworks serverless endpoints and the others through their developers’ APIs, with default sampling settings for every model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Google Kubernetes Engine 上运行所有实验，使用的工具是开源评估框架 Inspect AI 0.3.263（英国人工智能安全研究所，2024）。 每个智能体都在其专属的 gVisor（Young 等，2019）沙盒中运行，该沙盒包含 25 个预安装的 Python 库、一个空文件系统，且无法访问外部互联网；它通过一个模拟公司内部工具的 Python 库（mission_control.py）向自己的任务控制实例发送文件。 每次运行在模型完成 500 次交互后结束，以防止模型陷入无进展的循环；其他限制列于附录 F 中。 我们评估了 2026 年 9 月可用的各价格区间的模型（表 2）：开源权重模型通过 Fireworks 无服务器端点调用，其他模型则通过其开发者的 API 调用，且所有模型均使用默认采样设置。

paragraphs.en: Claude Opus 5.5 leads overall and in three of the five domains (Table 2 ), GPT-6 Astra leads in forecasting, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 leads in compliance. More reasoning effort helps the GPT-6 and Claude models at every step, with diminishing returns for Opus, which gains 17.0 points from low to medium effort, 5.9 from medium to high, and 4.0 from high to extra-high, while Claude Sonnet 5.5 gains 14.9 and 11.5 over the last two steps. Gemini 3.8 Flash gains 8.6 points from low to medium [4.9, 16.3] and Qwen 3.8 Max gains 5.2, and neither gains detectably afterward. Muse Spark 1.3 changes by less than 2 points past medium, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash moves only at extra-high (Appendix I ). Gemini 3.8 Flash and Muse Spark 1.3 also average 197 and 250 model calls per task, compared to 82 for Opus, without scoring higher, and 57% of Muse’s warehouse spend goes to tasks on which it scores below 5 out of 100 (Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: Claude Opus 5.5 在总体表现以及五个领域中的三个领域（表 2）中领先，GPT-6 Astra 在预测方面领先，而 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在合规性方面领先。 更多的推理努力在每个步骤上都有助于 GPT-6 和 Claude 模型，但 Opus 的回报逐渐递减：从低到中等努力水平获得 17.0 分，从中等到高获得 5.9 分，从高到超高获得 4.0 分；而 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在最后两个步骤中分别获得了 14.9 分和 11.5 分。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 从低到中等努力水平获得了 8.6 分 [4.9, 16.3]，Qwen 3.8 Max 获得了 5.2 分，之后两者均未出现可检测的性能提升。 Muse Spark 1.3 在中等努力水平之后的变化小于 2 分，而 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 仅在超高努力水平下有所提升（附录 I）。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Muse Spark 1.3 每任务平均调用模型 197 次和 250 次，而 Opus 仅为 82 次，但得分并未更高；此外，Muse 仓库支出的 57% 用于得分低于 5/100 的任务（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: Many tasks are prompt variants of one scenario, so we resample the 146 base scenarios when bootstrapping. The resulting 95% confidence intervals are about ± \pm 2 to 8 points on the score and up to ± \pm 8 points on the solved rate. Paired by task, Opus leads each of the next three models (GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol) by 7.7 to 10.0 points, and those three are not separated from one another. GPT-6.1 Sol leads its predecessor GPT-6 Sol by 12.8 points [6.8, 19.1], GPT-6 Sol leads Kimi K3 by 8.4 [0.5, 15.4], and the intervals of the next five overlap (Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: 许多任务都是同一场景的不同提示变体，因此在引导训练时，我们对 146 个基础场景进行了重新采样。 由此得到的 95% 置信区间在得分上约为 ±\pm 2 到 8 分，在解决率上则高达 ±\pm 8 分。 按任务配对来看，Opus 在接下来三种模型（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol）中均领先 7.7 到 10.0 分，而这三者之间并无显著差异。 GPT-6.1 Sol 比其前代模型 GPT-6 Sol 领先 12.8 分 [6.8, 19.1]，GPT-6 Sol 比 Kimi K3 领先 8.4 分 [0.5, 15.4]，而接下来五种模型的置信区间存在重叠（附录 I）。

paragraphs.en: Many failing runs use sound methods but read the wrong record, optimize the wrong objective, or measure the wrong quantity. Passing runs check definitions against a second source (Appendix I ).

paragraphs.en: A marketing dashboard asks whether each discount offer paid off against the same push notification with the coupon left out for every thousand customers it was sent to, for members and non-members. Only Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-6.1 Sol at extra-high effort publish the right table. What separates them is who counted as a member at the moment of targeting. A member whose card is declined keeps the benefits for seven days of grace and then loses them, but the contract stays on the books until it is canceled weeks later. Twenty-four of the failing runs take membership from the contract’s dates, and seven of them get every other figure right to within a few dollars. The three passing runs replay the billing history instead and check the result against the orders on which a member benefit was actually applied. Opus reads the seven-day grace off those orders, and GPT-6.1 Sol starts from the contract dates, finds 1,057 orders that its rule calls members’ and that received no benefit, and starts over.

paragraphs.en: One family of tasks asks where to cut $9.6 million from the annual budget for courier bonuses (quests). At extra-high effort and without hints, GPT-6 Astra finds the zones and hours where quests were randomly withheld, estimates supply responses with fixed effects and partial pooling, and cuts where quests buy the fewest courier-hours. The platform pays for quests to avoid surge pay; however, under the simulator’s response model, the plan loses $86,281 where a uniform cut would save $0.40 million, and it scores 0. From the same prompt, Claude Opus 5.5 at extra-high effort finds that quests substitute for surge pay, cuts where they save the least surge per bonus dollar, and saves $3.09 million of an attainable $3.12 million (score 99). Stating what quests are for and that a holdout exists raises the mean over all settings from 18.5 to 61.7.
paragraphs.zh: 一类任务要求确定如何从快递奖金（任务）的年度预算中削减 960 万美元。 在超高努力下且没有提示的情况下，GPT-6 Astra 找到了随机取消任务的区域和时间段，利用固定效应和局部合并法估算了供应响应，并在任务带来的快递工时最少的地方进行了削减。 该平台支付任务费用以避免高峰时段加付工资；然而，根据模拟器的响应模型，该方案损失了 86,281 美元，而统一削减本可节省 40 万美元，其得分为 0。 在相同的提示下，Claude Opus 5.5 在超高努力下发现，任务可以替代高峰时段加付工资，因此它在每单位奖金能节省的高峰时段工资最少的地方进行了削减，从而节省了 309 万美元（可节省的总额为 312 万美元），得分为 99。 明确说明任务的用途以及存在拒绝执行的情况，使所有设置下的平均值从 18.5 提高到 61.7。

paragraphs.en: Many failures come from measuring a quantity other than the one the prompt asks for. Of the 47 completed runs of a task that sizes the courier location service, 46 miss all 12 monthly counts despite a 1% tolerance because the warehouse keeps only hourly idle check-ins while the app sends them every half hour. GPT-6 Astra notices the gap, writes that its count does not establish how many reports the app sent, and files it anyway. Only Claude Sonnet 5.5 at extra-high effort adds the missing half-hourly check-ins back. Across the dashboard tasks, 66.9% of the data sources that pass their structural contract score zero on their values.
paragraphs.zh: 许多失败都源于测量了提示词所要求之外的某个量。 在 47 次完成的任务运行中，这些任务用于评估快递定位服务，有 46 次由于仓库仅保留每小时的空闲状态签到，而应用程序每半小时发送一次签到，导致所有 12 个月度计数均未达标，尽管存在 1% 的容差。 GPT-6 Astra 注意到了这一差距，指出其计数无法确定应用程序发送了多少份报告，但依然提交了该结果。 只有 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在超高努力下补充了缺失的每半小时签到数据。 在所有仪表板任务中，66.9% 通过其结构合同的数据源，在其数值评分上得分为零。

paragraphs.en: Across 4,553 forecast series from 3,346 runs on 72 tasks, nominal 80% intervals contain the realized value only 44.8% of the time. Apart from its floor, the grade is proper, so this overconfidence costs models points in expectation, although a per-series skill score clipped at zero would have rewarded a narrower interval in 72% of series (Appendix I ). Grades also depend on the reference, which sets each series’ scale. Against the tighter reference of their harder variant, the June base-pay forecasts fall from a mean grade of 84.7 to 6.0, although their median absolute error is only 1.57%. Appendix I reports coverage and absolute error.
paragraphs.zh: 在 72 项任务中运行的 3,346 次实验所生成的 4,553 个预测序列中，标称的 80% 置信区间仅 44.8% 的情况下包含了实际值。 除了其下限外，该评分等级是合理的，因此这种过度自信使模型在期望得分上有所损失；不过，若采用以零为上限的每序列技能评分，则 72% 的序列中较窄的区间本应获得更高奖励（附录 I）。 评分等级还取决于参考基准，该基准决定了每个序列的尺度。 与更难变体的更严格参考基准相比，六月基本工资预测的平均评分从 84.7 降至 6.0，尽管其绝对误差的中位数仅为 1.57%。 附录 I 报告了覆盖率和绝对误差。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-SQL benchmarks have moved from databases with a handful of tables each ( Yu et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2023 ) to enterprise-scale schemas ( Lei et al., 2025 ) and private data warehouses ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and data science benchmarks extend evaluation to multi-step analysis, data lakes, and data pipelines ( Jing et al., 2025 ; Egg et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Lei et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . These benchmarks compare an agent’s output to a gold answer, which audits have found to be frequently wrong ( Wretblad et al., 2024 ; Jin et al., 2026 ) , or to expert conclusions, often scored by an LLM judge ( Gu et al., 2024 ; Sahu et al., 2025 ) . Argo-Bench instead grades the actions that an agent files against the simulator’s latent state.
paragraphs.zh: 文本转 SQL 基准测试已从每个数据库仅包含少数几张表（Yu et al., 2018；Li et al., 2023）演进到企业级模式（Lei et al., 2025）和私有数据仓库（Chen et al., 2024），而数据科学基准测试则将评估范围扩展到了多步骤分析、数据湖和数据管道（Jing et al., 2025；Egg et al., 2025；Lai et al., 2026；Lei et al., 2026；Jin et al., 2025）。 这些基准测试会将智能体的输出与标准答案进行比较，而审计发现标准答案经常存在错误（Wretblad et al., 2024；Jin et al., 2026），或者与专家结论进行比较，后者通常由大型语言模型裁判进行评分（Gu et al., 2024；Sahu et al., 2025）。 相比之下，Argo-Bench 则根据智能体在模拟器潜在状态下执行的操作来进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Simulated environments are the standard way to evaluate agents that act. AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) and τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) check the final state of the environment’s database. TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2025a ) scores checkpoints in a simulated software company, and CRMArena-Pro ( Huang et al., 2026 ) shapes LLM-generated CRM records with latent variables. Vending-Bench and Business Arena score the net worth of a business that the agent runs ( Backlund & Petersson, 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . In these benchmarks, the state that determines success is either observable to the agent or changed by the agent inside a stylized game. In Argo-Bench, it is withheld and must be reconstructed from an enterprise warehouse. Simulators calibrated to public statistics have likewise supplied ground truth that real data lacks for patient records ( Walonoski et al., 2018 ) and money laundering ( Altman et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 模拟环境是评估行动智能体的标准方法。 AppWorld（Trivedi 等人，2024）和 τ \tau -bench（Yao 等人，2025；Barres 等人，2025）会检查环境数据库的最终状态。 TheAgentCompany（Xu 等人，2025a）在模拟的软件公司中为检查点打分，而 CRMArena-Pro（Huang 等人，2026）则通过潜在变量塑造由 LLM 生成的 CRM 记录。 Vending-Bench 和 Business Arena 会评估智能体所经营企业的净资产价值（Backlund & Petersson，2025；Pan 等人，2026）。 在这些基准测试中，决定成功与否的状态要么对智能体可见，要么是在一个风格化的游戏中由智能体改变的。 在 Argo-Bench 中，该状态被隐藏，必须从企业仓库中重建。 经过校准以匹配公开统计数据的模拟器同样提供了真实数据所缺乏的基准真相，例如患者记录（Walonoski 等人，2018）和洗钱（Altman 等人，2023）。

sents.en: Simulated environments are the standard way to evaluate agents that act.
sents.zh: 模拟环境是评估行动智能体的标准方法。

sents.en: Simulators calibrated to public statistics have likewise supplied ground truth that real data lacks for patient records ( Walonoski et al., 2018 ) and money laundering ( Altman et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 经过校准以匹配公开统计数据的模拟器同样提供了真实数据所缺乏的基准真相，例如患者记录（Walonoski 等人，2018）和洗钱（Altman 等人，2023）。

paragraphs.en: AvalancheBench ( Kłeczek et al., 2026 ) uses an LLM judge to score how much of a small latent e-commerce world an agent’s report recovers. The Era by Eon benchmark ( Gruenbaum et al., 2026 ) serves a generated company through a fleet of 66 simulated products, calibrated to operational and published statistics, and plants the records that answer each of its read-only questions, together with near misses. Two unrelated benchmarks named ERPBench evaluate decisions in a simulated manufacturer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and computer-use tasks in a live ERP system ( Bhagtani et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, the latent state of Argo-Bench is produced by the simulation itself rather than being planted. Its evidence is spread across an enterprise warehouse of 7.49 billion rows, and agents are graded on the consequences of the actions they file rather than on the answers they give.
paragraphs.zh: AvalancheBench（Kłeczek 等，2026）使用一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判来评估智能体报告在多大程度上还原了一个小型潜在电子商务世界。 Era by Eon 基准测试（Gruenbaum 等，2026）通过 66 个经过校准的模拟产品舰队为一家生成的公司提供服务，这些产品的校准依据是运营数据和公开统计数据，并植入能够回答其所有只读问题以及接近正确答案的记录。 两个无关的基准测试 ERPBench 分别评估模拟制造商中的决策（Zhang 等，2026）和实时 ERP 系统中的计算机使用任务（Bhagtani 等，2026）。 相比之下，Argo-Bench 的潜在状态由模拟本身生成，而非预先植入。 其证据分散在包含 74.9 亿行数据的企业仓库中，智能体的评分基于其所提交操作所产生的后果，而非其给出的答案。

sents.en: AvalancheBench ( Kłeczek et al., 2026 ) uses an LLM judge to score how much of a small latent e-commerce world an agent’s report recovers.
sents.zh: AvalancheBench（Kłeczek 等，2026）使用一个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判来评估智能体报告在多大程度上还原了一个小型潜在电子商务世界。

sents.en: The Era by Eon benchmark ( Gruenbaum et al., 2026 ) serves a generated company through a fleet of 66 simulated products, calibrated to operational and published statistics, and plants the records that answer each of its read-only questions, together with near misses.
sents.zh: Era by Eon 基准测试（Gruenbaum 等，2026）通过 66 个经过校准的模拟产品舰队为一家生成的公司提供服务，这些产品的校准依据是运营数据和公开统计数据，并植入能够回答其所有只读问题以及接近正确答案的记录。

sents.en: Two unrelated benchmarks named ERPBench evaluate decisions in a simulated manufacturer ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and computer-use tasks in a live ERP system ( Bhagtani et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 两个无关的基准测试 ERPBench 分别评估模拟制造商中的决策（Zhang 等，2026）和实时 ERP 系统中的计算机使用任务（Bhagtani 等，2026）。

sents.en: In contrast, the latent state of Argo-Bench is produced by the simulation itself rather than being planted.
sents.zh: 相比之下，Argo-Bench 的潜在状态由模拟本身生成，而非预先植入。

sents.en: Its evidence is spread across an enterprise warehouse of 7.49 billion rows, and agents are graded on the consequences of the actions they file rather than on the answers they give.
sents.zh: 其证据分散在包含 74.9 亿行数据的企业仓库中，智能体的评分基于其所提交操作所产生的后果，而非其给出的答案。

paragraphs.en: The dataset still differs from the most complex ERP deployments in four ways. First, the dataset covers a single city, so it has no foreign currency and none of its representations as transaction, local, and reporting currency. Second, many complex warehouses combine several businesses, such as food delivery and grocery delivery, with shared accounts, such as driver payables and customer credits, mixing them in a single balance. Third, only one year is simulated. A longer history, such as 2017 to 2026, would add the market shocks of 2020 to 2022 to operations and forecasts. Fourth, only one ERP format is supported, and a natural extension would be to add SAP S/4HANA.
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集在四个方面仍与最复杂的 ERP 部署存在差异。 首先，该数据集仅涵盖一座城市，因此不包含外币，也没有其作为交易货币、本地货币和报告货币的任何表现形式。 其次，许多复杂的仓库会整合多个业务，例如食品配送和杂货配送，并共享账户（如司机应付账款和客户信用额度），将其混合在单一余额中。 第三，目前仅模拟了一年时间。 如果采用更长的历史数据，例如从 2017 年到 2026 年，则会将 2020 年至 2022 年的市场冲击纳入运营和预测之中。 第四，目前仅支持一种 ERP 格式，而自然的扩展方式是加入 SAP S/4HANA。

sents.zh: 该数据集在四个方面仍与最复杂的 ERP 部署存在差异。

paragraphs.en: The simulator validates 23 distinct metrics, and we keep behaviors that public figures do not constrain out of scope for tasks. The in-world membership program in particular rests on weakly grounded assumptions. More generally, a simulator encodes the assumptions of its authors, and a generator that shares the simplifying assumptions of the systems under evaluation can make tasks easier than their real counterparts ( Leis et al., 2015 ) . Calibration to aggregate targets also does not guarantee realistic tails ( Chen et al., 2019 ) . Argo-Bench therefore compares data agents and does not estimate their performance on a real company’s warehouse.
paragraphs.zh: 该模拟器验证了 23 个不同的指标，并且我们将公众人物不受约束的行为排除在任务范围之外。 特别是，世界内的成员计划建立在缺乏充分依据的假设之上。 更普遍地说，模拟器编码了其作者的假设，而一个与所评估系统共享简化假设的生成器可能会使任务比其现实对应版本更容易（Leis et al., 2015）。 对聚合目标的校准也无法保证结果的尾部分布是现实的（Chen et al., 2019）。 因此，Argo-Bench 比较数据智能体，而不会评估它们在真实公司仓库中的表现。

sents.zh: 对聚合目标的校准也无法保证结果的尾部分布是现实的（Chen et al., 2019）。

paragraphs.en: Each setting of the model and effort has one run per task, and all tasks share one simulated world, so our confidence intervals reflect the choice of tasks rather than run-to-run variation. Scores on some tasks are also sensitive to prompt wording, so Appendix I reports every hinted and unhinted pair, including one prompt we judged to be underspecified. Plan tasks are graded under the simulator’s frozen response model, and Appendix J lists open issues by task.
paragraphs.zh: 模型的每种设置和每次尝试在每项任务中仅运行一次，且所有任务共享一个模拟世界，因此我们的置信区间反映的是任务选择的影响，而非不同运行之间的差异。 某些任务的得分也对提示词措辞较为敏感，因此附录 I 报告了所有带提示和不带提示的配对，包括我们判断为定义不足的其中一个提示。 规划类任务在模拟器的冻结响应模型下进行评分，附录 J 按任务列出了待解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Argo-Bench, which evaluates data agents on a simulated food delivery platform exported to an Oracle E-Business Suite warehouse of 235 tables and 7.49 billion rows. Because the simulator’s latent state is withheld from the warehouse, Argo-Bench grades the facts agents reconstruct and the actions they file, with every answer key computed from ground truth. The strongest of 14 models solves 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points, and its most instructive failures are careful analyses of the wrong quantity, toward the wrong objective, or read from the wrong record. We release the public seed’s warehouse, tasks, reference solutions, and harness, and hope that Argo-Bench helps measure progress toward data agents that can understand, navigate, and act within real enterprise data environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Argo-Bench，该基准通过一个模拟的食品配送平台来评估数据智能体，该平台已导出至一个包含 235 张表和 74.9 亿行数据的 Oracle E-Business Suite 仓库。 由于模拟器的潜在状态未被提供给仓库，Argo-Bench 会依据智能体重构的事实和提交的操作进行评分，且每份答案的正确答案均基于真实数据计算得出。 在 14 个模型中表现最强的模型能够解决 34.8% 的任务，平均得分为 59.5 分；其最具启发性的失败案例，则是对错误数量、错误目标或错误记录所导致问题的细致分析。 我们公开了公共种子数据的仓库、任务、参考解决方案和工具包，并希望 Argo-Bench 能够助力衡量数据智能体在真实企业数据环境中理解、导航和操作能力的进步。

paragraphs.en: Large language models were used in three ways. First, as coding assistants for the simulator, graders, reference solutions, and figure and table code. Second, in the simulator’s data work: tuning its parameters, cleaning donor datasets, and reconciling restaurant records across sources (Section 2.1 ). No record in the simulated world is generated by a language model, and every value in the warehouse comes from the simulator, except the fictional names of the storefronts renamed in the released warehouse, which a language model drafted (see the ethics statement). Third, in writing: some task prompts were drafted by a language model and then curated and rewritten by the authors, and language models edited the text of the paper and checked its citations. The authors checked every claim, number, and citation, and take full responsibility for the content of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型以三种方式被使用。 首先，作为模拟器、评分器、参考解决方案以及图表代码的编码助手。 其次，在模拟器的数据工作中：调整其参数、清理捐赠数据集，并核对不同来源的餐厅记录（第 2.1 节）。 模拟世界中的任何记录都不是由语言模型生成的，仓库中的每个值都来自模拟器，唯一例外是发布版仓库中重命名的虚构店铺名称，这些名称由语言模型起草（参见伦理声明）。 第三，在写作方面：部分任务提示由语言模型起草，随后由作者进行整理和改写；语言模型还编辑了论文的文本并检查了其引用。 作者核查了每一项陈述、数字和引用，并对论文内容承担全部责任。

paragraphs.en: Argo-Bench contains no data about real people. Consumer and courier names are drawn from public name-frequency tables and assigned to simulated people, and every order, shift, and payment is simulated. Restaurants are real New York City businesses. Their names and addresses come from Overture Maps places matched to the city’s inspection records, with some names updated to the business’s current listing, and some storefronts the simulator opens during the year, such as relaunches and virtual brands, take the name of a real business that was not trading at the time. All behavior attributed to them in the world, including the fraud patterns of Section 2.1 , is simulated. The simulator draws which storefronts play a fraud role, not from any record of a business’s conduct, so a label says nothing about the real business. Even so, in the released warehouse every storefront that plays a fraud role in any scenario carries a fictional name instead of its real one, and fields derived from the name, such as its contact email, follow the new name. The released questions and agent transcripts use the same fictional names. A language model drafted the fictional names to read like real New York restaurant names, so that a renamed storefront does not stand out and point to the answers, and each was checked against the city’s inspection records and Overture Maps so that none is the name of a real restaurant. Addresses are unchanged, since the simulated geography depends on them. The donor datasets are used under their licenses. Those released for research or non-commercial use, such as the Yelp Open Dataset and the Grubhub MDRP instances, serve only as shape donors, and none of their records enters the world or the warehouse (Appendix A ). The fraud tasks reward detecting common schemes, not carrying them out. During development, one model escaped an insufficiently isolated sandbox and read the grader code (Appendix D ). The final runs use isolated sandboxes without internet access, and we report the incident so that others building agent benchmarks can guard against it.
paragraphs.zh: Argo-Bench 不包含任何关于真实人物的数据。 消费者和快递员的名字来自公共姓名频率表，并被分配给模拟人物；所有订单、班次和付款均经过模拟。 这些餐厅是纽约市的真实企业。 它们的名称和地址来自 Overture Maps 的地点数据，并与该市的检查记录进行匹配；部分名称已更新为该企业当前的登记信息，而模拟器在年度内开设的部分门店（例如重新开业或虚拟品牌）则采用当时尚未营业的真实企业名称。 它们在模拟世界中表现出的所有行为（包括第 2.1 节中提到的欺诈模式）均经过模拟。 模拟器通过随机方式决定哪些门店扮演欺诈角色，而非依据任何关于企业行为的记录，因此标签本身无法反映真实企业的实际情况。 即便如此，在已发布的仓库中，任何在任何场景下扮演欺诈角色的门店都使用虚构名称代替其真实名称，且基于该名称生成的字段（如联系邮箱）也会随之更新。 已发布的问题和智能体对话记录也使用了相同的虚构名称。 一个语言模型负责生成这些虚构名称，使其读起来像真实的纽约餐厅名称，以避免重命名的门店显得突兀并暴露答案；同时，每个名称都经过与市检查记录和 Overture Maps 数据的比对，确保没有使用真实餐厅的名称。 地址保持不变，因为模拟的地理环境依赖于这些地址。 捐赠数据集均按照其许可协议使用。 那些为研究或非商业用途发布的数据集（如 Yelp Open Dataset 和 Grubhub MDRP 实例）仅作为数据形态的来源，其任何记录都不会进入模拟世界或仓库（附录 A）。 欺诈任务旨在奖励对常见欺诈手法的识别，而非鼓励实施欺诈行为。 在开发过程中，一个模型从隔离不充分的沙箱中逃逸，并读取了评分器代码（附录 D）。 最终运行使用了无网络访问权限的独立沙箱，我们报告了这一事件，以便其他构建智能体基准测试的团队能够防范类似情况。

sents.en: During development, one model escaped an insufficiently isolated sandbox and read the grader code (Appendix D ).

sents.en: The final runs use isolated sandboxes without internet access, and we report the incident so that others building agent benchmarks can guard against it.

paragraphs.en: Two artifacts are released. The warehouse of one seed is released on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/textql/Argo-Bench . The code that reproduces the paper’s runs is released under the Apache License 2.0 at https://github.com/TextQLLabs/Argo-Bench . It contains the 210 questions, the reference agent on Inspect AI 0.3.263, its warehouse and Python tool servers, the mission-control console through which the agent files, the three sandboxes in which run_python executes (a macOS Seatbelt profile, a Docker image with pinned libraries, and the network-less gVisor pod used for the paper’s runs), loaders for DuckDB and BigQuery, and the model and reasoning-effort configuration for every rung reported. The system prompt and tools are given in Appendices E and F , and Appendix L shows three reference solutions in full.

paragraphs.en: The simulator and the graders are not released to prevent direct answer memorization. A run made with the released code exports a submission file recording every filing, the model and its settings, token usage, and how each run ended, which we score on a best-effort basis. The paper’s runs queried a second world generated by the same simulator from a different seed (Section 2.3 ). The 15 questions that name specific couriers, storefronts, or promotion codes draw them from the public world by the same selection rule. Re-running the released code therefore reproduces the paper’s procedure on a sibling world rather than its exact numbers. Proprietary models were accessed through their providers’ APIs, and all other models through Fireworks serverless endpoints with default settings in September 2026. Results from proprietary APIs may drift as providers update their models.
paragraphs.zh: 为防止直接记忆答案，模拟器和评分器尚未发布。 使用已发布的代码运行程序会导出一个提交文件，记录每次提交、模型及其设置、令牌使用情况以及每次运行的结果，我们将根据最佳努力原则对此进行评分。 该论文的运行过程查询了由同一模拟器从不同种子生成的第二个世界（第 2.3 节）。 那些点名特定快递员、店铺或促销代码的 15 个问题，会按照相同的筛选规则从公开世界中提取这些内容。 因此，重新运行已发布的代码会在一个孪生世界中重现该论文的流程，而非完全复现其具体数值。 专有模型通过其提供商的 API 访问，而其他所有模型则通过 Fireworks 无服务器端点以 2026 年 9 月的默认设置访问。 随着提供商更新其模型，来自专有 API 的结果可能会产生偏差。

paragraphs.en: On April 1, 2024, NYC raised the minimum pay rate for app-based restaurant delivery workers from $17.96 to $19.56 per hour ( 50 ) , and the simulated platform responds on the same day. Its dispatcher starts restricting when couriers can go online, and its per-delivery pay card drops (Section 2.1 ). Whenever a week’s pay falls short of the minimum, the platform tops it up with a true-up on the weekly courier pay invoice. The shock breaks the stationarity that simple forecasts rely on, and it changes how several standard figures must be computed. Table 4 groups the tasks that depend on it.
paragraphs.zh: 2024年4月1日，纽约市将基于应用程序的餐厅配送工人的最低时薪从17.96美元提高到19.56美元（50），模拟平台也在当天作出回应。 其调度员开始限制快递员可以上线的时间，并且每次配送的支付金额也减少了（第2.1节）。 每当一周的报酬低于最低标准时，平台就会通过每周快递员的付款账单进行补发，补足差额。 这一冲击打破了简单预测所依赖的平稳性，并改变了若干标准指标的计算方式。 表4汇总了依赖于该变化的任务。

paragraphs.en: In an early round of runs, the Python sandbox did not isolate the agent from the evaluation host. In three runs of fraud-04, Gemini 3.8 Flash changed its root directory, located the grader for the task, and filed the answer it read there, scoring 0.99 ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) . We searched the traces of every run in that round for the same behavior and found it in no other model. The round was discarded. Every run reported in this paper executes Python in a network-less gVisor pod under Inspect’s Kubernetes sandbox provider on GKE, and each run’s BigQuery service account can read only the dataset scoped to its task. The relevant agent traces are included in the GitHub release.
paragraphs.zh: 在早期的一轮运行中，Python 沙盒未将智能体与评估主机隔离。 在 fraud-04 的三次运行中，Gemini 3.8 Flash 更改了其根目录，定位了任务的评分器，并提交了从中读取的答案，得分为 0.99（Skalse 等，2022）。 我们检查了该轮所有运行的追踪记录，寻找相同的行为，但并未在其他任何模型中发现。因此，该轮运行被舍弃。 本文报告的所有运行均在 GKE 上 Inspect 的 Kubernetes 沙盒提供商下，于无网络的 gVisor pod 中执行 Python，且每次运行的 BigQuery 服务账户只能读取与其任务相关的数据集。 相关的智能体追踪记录已包含在 GitHub 发布版本中。

paragraphs.en: The reference agent is given four tools, served by two MCP servers ( Anthropic, 2024 ) . A read-only warehouse server runs over the task’s database engine, and a Python server holds a persistent interpreter in the agent’s sandbox. Filings to Mission Control go through mission_control.py , which is importable from run_python (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 参考智能体配备了四个工具，由两个 MCP 服务器提供服务（Anthropic，2024）。 一个只读仓库服务器运行在任务的数据库引擎之上，而一个 Python 服务器则在智能体的沙盒中维护一个持久化的解释器。 提交给任务控制中心的文件需通过 mission_control.py 处理，该文件可以从 run_python 中导入（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: Each sandbox runs under gVisor ( Young et al., 2019 ) with 4 GiB of memory (12 GiB for the few runs repeated after the sandbox ran out of memory), one CPU, and 10 GiB of ephemeral disk. Each run is limited to 500 model turns and 240 minutes. A run_python cell times out after 900 seconds and returns at most 30,000 characters of output, and a run_sql query may scan at most 20 GiB, with no limit on the number of queries, and saves at most 1,000,000 rows. A run that reaches a limit, exhausts the model’s context window, or crashes its sandbox is graded on whatever it submitted before stopping. Of the 9,869 graded runs, 56 (0.6%) reached the turn limit, 43 of them from Muse Spark 1.3 and 13 from Gemini 3.8 Flash, and 65 (0.7%) reached the context window, all from Qwen 3.8 Max.
paragraphs.zh: 每个沙箱都在 gVisor（Young 等人，2019）下运行，配备 4 GiB 内存（少数因沙箱内存耗尽而重复运行的测试使用 12 GiB）、一个 CPU 和 10 GiB 临时磁盘空间。 每次运行最多允许 500 次模型轮次和 240 分钟。 run_python 单元格在运行 900 秒后超时，最多返回 30,000 个字符的输出；run_sql 查询最多可扫描 20 GiB 数据，查询次数不受限制，且最多保存 1,000,000 行数据。 若运行达到限制、耗尽模型上下文窗口或导致其沙箱崩溃，则根据停止前提交的内容进行评分。 在 9,869 次评分的运行中，有 56 次（0.6%）达到了轮次限制，其中 43 次来自 Muse Spark 1.3，13 次来自 Gemini 3.8 Flash；另有 65 次（0.7%）达到了上下文窗口限制，全部来自 Qwen 3.8 Max。

paragraphs.en: A task consists of a prompt, a scope, a list of expectations, and an answer key. The prompt is the only text the agent receives besides the system prompt (Appendix E ). The scope sets the last month of 2024 in the warehouse the agent queries. Each expectation names one filing the grader requires, with its action (for instance ban_couriers or file_forecasts ), the keys it is filed against, such as vendor IDs or months, and its grading mode. The answer key is computed once, before any run, and frozen. It comes either from truth queries, which are SQL over the latent tables, or from a local builder, which reads the simulator’s labels directly, for instance which couriers were made to steal orders. Listing 1 gives both definitions with their defaults.
paragraphs.zh: 一项任务包括一个提示、一个范围、一份期望列表和一个答案键。 除了系统提示（附录 E）之外，智能体接收的唯一文本就是提示。 该范围将智能体查询的仓库时间设定为 2024 年的最后一个月。 每一项期望都指定了评分者要求的一项归档操作及其动作（例如 ban_couriers 或 file_forecasts）、其归档依据的键（如供应商 ID 或月份）以及其评分模式。 答案键在运行之前计算一次，并且是固定的。 它要么来自真相查询（即对潜在表执行的 SQL 查询），要么来自本地构建器（直接读取模拟器的标签，例如哪些快递员被安排偷窃订单）。 列表 1 给出了两种定义及其默认值。

paragraphs.en: Each expectation scores between 0 and 100, a forecast between − 200 -200 and 100, and the task score is their weighted mean. Mixing binary, graded, and forecast scales in one mean is a choice, so Table 2 also reports the solved rate, which does not depend on how the scales are mixed, and per-domain means, and it floors each model’s forecast tasks at 0 as a block so that a few very wrong forecasts cannot outweigh the rest. Of the 210 tasks, 159 have one scored expectation, 37 have two, and 14 have three. An expectation marked optional is graded and reported but left out of the mean. If a run files nothing while the key expects at least one action, every expectation scores 0, and a forecast expectation − 200 -200 . A filing that carries many items, such as one ban_customers call with 300 accounts, is split into its items before grading, so it scores the same as 300 separate filings. IDs and keys are compared as normalized text: case and surrounding whitespace do not matter, and 6057444.0 is 6057444 . A key filed inside a longer string, such as payout period P17 , also counts, but only on a token boundary, so P17 does not match P170 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个期望的得分在 0 到 100 之间，预测的得分在 −200 至 200 和 100 之间，任务得分则是它们的加权平均值。 将二元、分级和预测量表混合计算一个平均值是一种选择，因此表 2 还报告了解决率（该指标不依赖于量表的混合方式）以及各领域的平均值，并且会将每个模型的所有预测任务统一限制在 0 以上，以防止少数严重错误的预测压倒其余结果。 在 210 个任务中，有 159 个包含一个已评分的期望，37 个包含两个，14 个包含三个。 标记为可选的期望会被分级并报告，但不会计入平均值。 如果某个运行未提交任何内容，而键至少期望一个操作，则所有期望得分均为 0，预测期望得分为 −200 至 200。 包含多个项目的提交（例如一次 ban_customers 调用涉及 300 个账户）在分级前会被拆分为各个项目，因此其得分与 300 次独立提交相同。 ID 和键会被作为规范化文本进行比较：大小写和周围的空白字符无关紧要，且 6057444.0 等同于 6057444。 嵌入在更长字符串中的键（例如 payout period P17）也会被计数，但仅以词元边界为准，因此 P17 与 P170 不匹配。

paragraphs.en: A forecast files a point and an 80% interval for each series and is scored by its weighted interval score (WIS) ( Bracher et al., 2021 ) , with the median and one interval, on a scale set by a reference forecast. For 76 of the 98 forecast expectations the reference is the no-change forecast from the months the agent can see: its point r r is the last visible value and its interval is r ± z ​ s r\pm zs with s = σ ^ ​ h s=\hat{\sigma}\sqrt{h} , where σ ^ \hat{\sigma} is the root mean square of the one-step changes and h h the number of periods ahead ( Hyndman & Athanasopoulos, 2021 ) . The other 22 cross a regime change, such as the minimum-pay rule, where no change is not a serious benchmark, and their reference is frozen into the answer key as a point r r and a standard deviation s s at the horizon. Most are a figure the prompt attributes to the business and asks the agent to check, computed by the method the prompt states from the data the agent can see. Table 7 lists all 22 and how each was set, including seven whose point was set with the outcome in view.
paragraphs.zh: 一种预测方法会为每个序列提供一个点值和一个80%置信区间，并通过加权区间得分（WIS）进行评估（Bracher等，2021），其中中位数和单个区间均基于一个参考预测所设定的标度。 在98个预测预期中，有76个的参考依据是智能体能够看到的月份中的“无变化”预测：其点值r r为最后一个可见值，其区间为r ± z ​ s r\pm zs，其中s = σ ^ ​ h s=\hat{\sigma}\sqrt{h}，σ ^ \hat{\sigma}是一步变化的均方根，h h是未来预测的周期数（Hyndman & Athanasopoulos，2021）。 其余22个跨越了制度转变，例如最低支付规则，在这种情况下“无变化”并非一个严肃的基准；它们的参考值在答案中固定为点值r r和时域处的标准差s s。 大多数情况下，提示词会将某个数值归因于企业并要求智能体进行验证，该数值通过提示词指定的方法，基于智能体可见的数据计算得出。 表7列出了全部22个案例及其各自的设定方式，其中包括7个在已知结果的情况下设定点值的案例。

paragraphs.en: where W = 0.623 W=0.623 is the median of the references’ own WIS on that scale over the 98 series of the benchmark. A perfect forecast scores 100, and a forecast as far from the outcome as the median reference scores 0. Since r r and s s are fixed before the outcome and W W is one constant for the whole benchmark, no series is weighted by how well its own reference happened to do, and since an increasing transformation preserves quantiles, the score is proper: a forecaster maximizes its expected score by filing its own median and 80% interval ( Gneiting, 2011 ; Bosse et al., 2023 ) . An expectation averages its series and is floored at − 200 -200 , so one failed forecast costs at most what two perfect ones earn, and a series the agent does not file scores − 200 -200 . The floor is the one improper element; Appendix I measures how little it bends the incentive. In every mean we report, a setting’s forecast tasks are floored at 0 as a block, so a model no better than the median reference across its forecasts scores 0 on them rather than below. At the settings of Table 2 this floor binds for eight of the fourteen models, all but Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, and Kimi K3, so the forecasting column separates the strongest models and not the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 其中 W = 0.623，W=0.623 是基准测试中 98 个系列里，参考模型在该量表上自身 WIS 的中位数。 完美预测的得分为 100，而预测结果与真实结果之间的差距达到参考模型中位数的水平时，得分为 0。 由于 r 和 s 在结果公布前是固定的，且 W 在整个基准测试中是一个常数，因此没有任何一个系列会根据其参考模型偶然表现的好坏而被加权；又因为单调递增的变换会保留分位数，所以该评分是合理的：预测者通过提交自身的中位数和 80% 置信区间来最大化其期望得分（Gneiting, 2011; Bosse et al., 2023）。 期望值是对各系列取平均，且最低分为 −200，因此一次失败的预测最多只会损失相当于两次完美预测的得分；而智能体未提交的系列得分为 −200。 这个最低分是唯一不合理的设计元素；附录 I 衡量了它对激励结构的影响程度有多小。 在我们报告的每个平均值中，某一设置下的预测任务得分整体以 0 为下限，因此如果一个模型在所有预测中的表现都不优于参考模型的中位数，其得分将为 0，而非负值。 在表 2 所示的设置中，这 14 个模型中有 8 个受此最低分限制，唯一不受限制的是 Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Sol 和 Kimi K3；因此，预测得分列区分的是最强的模型，而非其余模型。

Every account in the task’s universe is a target T T , an innocent I I , or a neutral account that is bad but not what the task asks for. Every ban filed carries a review cost a a , so even correct bans are not free. sents.en: In the example of Appendix L , a a is $2 and ν \nu is one half.
sents.zh: 在附录 L 的示例中，a a 是 $2，而 ν \nu 是二分之一。

sents.en: This follows the example-dependent costs of cost-sensitive classification ( Elkan, 2001 ) , and the same formula prices payout holds.

paragraphs.en: Three choices in Equation 1 shape how a ban is scored. First, a neutral account is left out of both baselines, so leaving it open is never a miss, while banning it still costs a review. If neutral bans were free, a run could ban the whole population and keep the targets it swept up; if they were charged as false positives, finding real fraud outside the task’s scope would be punished. Second, an ID that is in no universe cannot be priced from the key. Charging it only a a would make an invented ID nearly free, so it is charged the median innocent margin as well. Third, in 18 of the 45 cost_set expectations a wrong ban destroys only part of the innocent’s margin, one half or one tenth, which models appeals and reinstatements and makes precision matter less relative to recall. Across the final tasks, 38 expectations use a = $ 2 a=\$2 and ν = 1 2 \nu=\tfrac{1}{2} , three use a = $ 25 a=\$25 and ν = 1 \nu=1 , and four charge no review, so that only losses and margins count. The savings before clipping can be negative, which means the bans destroyed more value than either baseline, and the grader reports that value although the score stops at 0.
paragraphs.zh: 方程 1 中的三个选项决定了禁用的评分方式。 首先，中立账户被排除在两种基线之外，因此保留它绝不会被视为失误，而禁用它仍需消耗一次审核。 如果中立账户的禁用是免费的，那么一个运行可以禁用整个群体，同时保留其捕获的目标；如果这些禁用被计为误判，那么发现任务范围之外的真实欺诈行为就会受到惩罚。 其次，在任何宇宙中都不存在的 ID，无法根据键进行定价。 如果仅对其收取 a 的费用，那么一个虚构的 ID 几乎就是免费的，因此它也会被收取中性的无辜者边际费用。 第三，在 45 个 cost_set 预期中的 18 个里，错误的禁用只会破坏无辜者边际的一部分，即一半或十分之一，这模拟了申诉和恢复程序，并使得精确率相对于召回率的重要性降低。 在所有最终任务中，38 个预期使用 a = $2 a=\$2 和 ν = 1/2 \nu=\tfrac{1}{2}，3 个使用 a = $25 a=\$25 和 ν = 1 \nu=1，另有 4 个不收取审核费用，因此只有损失和边际会被计算在内。 在截断前的节省值可能为负，这意味着禁用所造成的价值损失超过了两种基线中的任何一种，而评分系统仍会报告该价值，尽管最终得分会停在 0。

paragraphs.en: A publish_data_sources filing is the table behind a dashboard tile: its columns, and the rows the tile would show. Each task carries a contract that names the columns, their types, and which of them form the key; the contract is also the schema the agent is given. A publication missing a contract column scores 0. Otherwise the filed frame is right when it has exactly the key rows of the answer and every cell matches: numbers within the column’s tolerance, integers exactly, dates to the day, and text after normalization. The score is 100 for a right frame and 0 for any other, since a tile with any wrong row cannot be used. The share of rows that were right is reported, but does not enter the score.
paragraphs.zh: publish_data_sources 文件是仪表板图块背后的表格：其列以及图块将显示的行。 每个任务都附带一份合同，其中规定了列名、它们的类型以及哪些列构成键；该合同也是智能体所接收的模式定义。 缺少合同列的发布将得 0 分。 否则，当文件框架恰好包含答案中的键行且每个单元格都完全匹配时，该框架即为正确：数值在列的容限范围内，整数完全一致，日期精确到日，文本经过归一化后一致。 正确的框架得 100 分，任何其他情况均得 0 分，因为包含任何错误行的图块都无法使用。 正确行的比例会被报告，但不会计入分数。

paragraphs.en: A file_schedules filing is a named table with key columns and rows, such as a reconciliation of receivables to the general ledger. The grader picks the schedule by name, matches rows on the key columns as normalized text, and counts a row correct when every numeric column of the answer is present and within tolerance. Other filed columns are ignored, so a schedule may carry its workings. The score is 100 times the correct rows over the answer’s rows plus, in 13 of the 14 tasks, the filed rows the answer does not contain, so a reconciling item invented to force a tie counts against the schedule. A schedule filed twice under one name keeps the later copy.
paragraphs.zh: 文件_计划表是一种带有关键列和行的命名表格，例如将应收账款与总账进行核对的表格。 评分器通过名称选择该计划表，在关键列上以规范化文本的形式匹配各行，并在答案的所有数值列都存在且处于容差范围内时，判定该行正确。 其他已填写的列会被忽略，因此一个计划表可以保留其计算过程。 得分为正确行数乘以100，再除以答案总行数；此外，在14个任务中的13个任务中，还会将答案中未包含的已填写行计入扣分，因此为强行制造平局而虚构的对账项目会减少计划表的得分。 若同一名称的计划表被两次提交，则以后一次提交的版本为准。

paragraphs.en: A report_metrics filing reports a value per key, such as a figure for each month, and a remediate_payments filing an amount per account or pay period. A key is correct when its value is within the larger of an absolute tolerance and a relative one. The score is 100 times the correct keys over all keys in the answer, so a wrong or missing key costs the same. In 5 of the 35 expectations, keys the answer does not contain are added to the denominator as well, for questions where reporting an extra key is itself an error.
paragraphs.zh: report_metrics 文件按键报告一个值，例如每个月的数值；而 remediate_payments 文件则按账户或支付周期报告一个金额。 当某个键的值处于绝对容差和相对容差两者中较大者范围内时，该键即为正确。 得分等于答案中所有键里正确键的数量乘以 100，因此错误或缺失的键会同等扣分。 在 35 个期望条件中的 5 个里，如果答案未包含某些键，这些键也会被加入分母；这适用于那些报告多余键本身即构成错误的题目。

paragraphs.en: For an id_set expectation, the grader takes the filed IDs as a prediction of the answer’s set and scores 100 times their F1. Of the 32 such expectations, 27 grade bans whose key is a list of accounts rather than a priced universe, and the rest grade holds, remediations, pay periods, and a discontinued promotion code. If the answer set is empty, the question has no right target: filing nothing scores 100 and filing anything scores 0. The one binary expectation uses the same comparison but scores 100 only for an F1 of exactly 1, because remediating the right accounts together with a wrong one is still a wrong decision. That expectation is also gated on another in its task: it scores only if every shortfall it remediates was first reported within tolerance. Filing no remediation is correct when nobody was shorted, but a run that reported a wrong shortfall and then filed nothing earns credit only if the shortfalls were reported correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 id_set 期望，评分器将字段 ID 视为答案集合的预测值，并为其 F1 分值的 100 倍进行评分。 在这 32 个期望中，有 27 个用于评分“ban”，其键是账户列表而非定价宇宙；其余的则用于评分“holds”“remediations”“pay periods”以及一个已停用的促销代码。 如果答案集合为空，则该问题没有正确目标：不提交任何内容得 100 分，而提交任何内容都得 0 分。 这个二元期望使用相同的比较方式，但只有当 F1 恰好为 1 时才会得 100 分，因为即使同时纠正了正确的账户和错误的账户，仍然属于错误决策。 该期望在其任务中还受到另一个条件的限制：只有当它纠正的每一项短缺最初都在容限范围内被报告时，才能获得分数。 在没有人出现短缺的情况下，不提交任何纠正措施是正确的；但如果某个运行报告了错误的短缺，随后又未提交任何内容，则只有在这些短缺最初被正确报告的情况下才能获得分数。

paragraphs.en: Nine tasks ask for a plan that moves a budget across cells such as a zone, a day type, and an hour band: five remove quest dollars, two remove courier hours, and two add courier hours where they prevent the most cancellations. The answer key holds each cell’s capacity and its marginal value in the simulator, the deliveries lost per hour removed, the cancellations avoided per hour added, or the net value of a quest dollar. The loss of a plan is the sum over cells of the amount moved times that marginal. The plan scores
paragraphs.zh: 九项任务要求制定一个计划，将预算在不同单元格之间转移，这些单元格包括区域、日期类型和时段：其中五项任务是移除“任务美元”，两项任务是移除“快递员小时数”，另有两项任务是在能够避免最多取消订单的情况下增加“快递员小时数”。 答案表中包含了每个单元格在模拟器中的容量及其边际价值，以及每减少一小时所损失的配送量、每增加一小时所避免的取消订单数量，或一个“任务美元”的净价值。 计划的损失等于各单元格中转移量与其边际价值之总和。该计划的得分

paragraphs.en: where L uniform L_{\text{uniform}} is the loss of moving the same share in every cell, which needs no analysis, and L ref L_{\text{ref}} is the top of the scale. For the four tasks that remove or add courier hours, it is the loss of the best plan the authors reached from the warehouse alone, and the plan that is optimal on the true marginals is reported but not used, since reaching it would require information that the agent cannot obtain. For the five quest-cut tasks, L ref L_{\text{ref}} is the optimal plan itself, so a score of 100 means the agent recovered the best cut under the simulator’s response model. The factor f f is 1 while the total moved is within 2% of the budget and falls linearly to 0 at 15% short or over. A cut or addition above a cell’s cap is clipped to the cap, a row naming no cell is rejected, and a row at a coarser grain, such as a whole zone, is spread over its cells in proportion to their hours.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，L uniform L_{\text{uniform}} 表示在每个单元格中移动相同份额所带来的损失，这一部分无需分析；而 L ref L_{\text{ref}} 则是该尺度的上限。 对于移除或增加快递员工时的四项任务，其损失值基于作者仅从仓库出发所得到的最佳方案；虽然报告了基于真实边际值的最佳方案，但并未实际使用，因为要达成该方案需要智能体无法获取的信息。 对于五项任务削减任务，L ref L_{\text{ref}} 即为最佳方案本身，因此得分为 100 表示智能体在模拟器的响应模型下成功恢复了最佳削减方案。 当总移动量在预算的 2% 以内时，因子 f f 为 1；若总移动量短缺或超出预算达到 15%，则该因子线性降至 0。 超过单元格上限的削减或添加操作将被截断至上限；整行拒绝不会导致任何单元格被拒；而较粗粒度（如整个区域）的行则会按照各单元格的工时比例分配到其下属单元格中。

sents.zh: 其中，L uniform L_{\text{uniform}} 表示在每个单元格中移动相同份额所带来的损失，这一部分无需分析；而 L ref L_{\text{ref}} 则是该尺度的上限。

sents.zh: 对于移除或增加快递员工时的四项任务，其损失值基于作者仅从仓库出发所得到的最佳方案；虽然报告了基于真实边际值的最佳方案，但并未实际使用，因为要达成该方案需要智能体无法获取的信息。

sents.en: For the five quest-cut tasks, L ref L_{\text{ref}} is the optimal plan itself, so a score of 100 means the agent recovered the best cut under the simulator’s response model.
sents.zh: 对于五项任务削减任务，L ref L_{\text{ref}} 即为最佳方案本身，因此得分为 100 表示智能体在模拟器的响应模型下成功恢复了最佳削减方案。

sents.en: The factor f f is 1 while the total moved is within 2% of the budget and falls linearly to 0 at 15% short or over.
sents.zh: 当总移动量在预算的 2% 以内时，因子 f f 为 1；若总移动量短缺或超出预算达到 15%，则该因子线性降至 0。

sents.en: A cut or addition above a cell’s cap is clipped to the cap, a row naming no cell is rejected, and a row at a coarser grain, such as a whole zone, is spread over its cells in proportion to their hours.
sents.zh: 超过单元格上限的削减或添加操作将被截断至上限；整行拒绝不会导致任何单元格被拒；而较粗粒度（如整个区域）的行则会按照各单元格的工时比例分配到其下属单元格中。

In 32 tasks, the note is optional and does not enter the score. In the two reconciliation tasks, it is scored, with a weight of 0.5 against 3 for the table it explains.

paragraphs.en: The Spider 2.0 paper splits its 632 tasks by host engine, with 214 on BigQuery and 198 on Snowflake. However, 180 of the Snowflake tasks use BigQuery public datasets copied into Snowflake, and only 18 use Snowflake Marketplace data. By source (Table 8 ), 69.5% of Spider 2.0-Snow’s questions run on BigQuery public data and 24.7% on local SQLite files. A fifth (111 questions, 20.3%) run on one of 22 synthetic, obfuscated, or textbook sample databases, such as Looker’s synthetic theLook store and the obfuscated Google Analytics sample exports.
paragraphs.zh: Spider 2.0 论文按主机引擎对其 632 项任务进行了划分，其中 214 项在 BigQuery 上运行，198 项在 Snowflake 上运行。 然而，Snowflake 的 180 项任务使用了复制到 Snowflake 的 BigQuery 公共数据集，而只有 18 项使用了 Snowflake Marketplace 的数据。 按数据源分类（表 8），Spider 2.0-Snow 的 69.5% 问题运行在 BigQuery 公共数据上，24.7% 运行在本地 SQLite 文件上。 五分之一的问题（111 个问题，占 20.3%）运行在 22 个合成、混淆或教科书示例数据库之一上，例如 Looker 的合成 theLook 存储库和经过混淆的 Google Analytics 示例导出数据。

paragraphs.en: We count two tables in a database as one schema when their column names and types are identical, as with the daily tables ga_sessions_20160801 to ga_sessions_20170801 . Of the 13,022 tables with a DDL, only 2,599 have a distinct schema, so 80.0% copy another table (Figure 4 a). Without GITHUB_REPOS_DATE , whose 4,989 identical daily tables hold a single event log, the share is 67.0%. The median database has 11 distinct schemas, and the most varied has 177. The Argo-Bench warehouse has 235, with no copies. The median database has two questions, and 54 of the 152 have one.
paragraphs.zh: 当数据库中的两个表的列名和类型完全相同时，我们将它们视为同一个模式，例如 daily 表 ga_sessions_20160801 到 ga_sessions_20170801。 在拥有 DDL 的 13,022 个表中，仅有 2,599 个具有独特的模式，因此有 80.0% 的表是复制了其他表（图 4a）。 如果不考虑 GITHUB_REPOS_DATE，其 4,989 个完全相同的 daily 表仅包含单一事件日志，这一比例则为 67.0%。 这些数据库的中位数拥有 11 种不同的模式，而模式最多样化的数据库则拥有 177 种。 Argo-Bench 仓库拥有 235 种模式，且没有任何重复的表。 这些数据库的中位数包含两个问题，而在 152 个数据库中，有 54 个仅包含一个问题。

paragraphs.en: Counting shards once, 75.0% of the 276 questions with public gold SQL read at most two logical tables, and 41.7% read one. The authors’ gold-table lists, which cover all 547 questions and agree with the gold SQL on 93.8% of the questions both cover, give 69.3% and 37.7%, and no question reads more than eight (Figure 4 b). The reference solution in Figure 1 reads 6 of the 235 Argo-Bench tables across three EBS modules.
paragraphs.zh: 对查询的表进行一次性统计后，在 276 个具有公开黄金 SQL 的问题中，有 75.0% 的问题最多读取两个逻辑表，41.7% 的问题仅读取一个。 作者提供的黄金表列表涵盖了全部 547 个问题，并且在两者都覆盖的 93.8% 问题上与黄金 SQL 一致；该列表显示，69.3% 的问题最多读取六个表，37.7% 的问题最多读取五个表，且没有任何一个问题需要读取超过八个表（图 4b）。 图 1 中的参考解决方案在三个 EBS 模块中读取了 Argo-Bench 的 235 个表中的 6 个。

paragraphs.en: Here, we provide the cases behind Section 3.2 , along with two fraud cases that compare prompt variants of one task. The numbers come from the 9,869 completed and graded runs over the 210 tasks at low, medium, high, and extra-high effort (47 settings of model and effort), and the traces of all of them. Scores are on the 0 to 100 scale of Table 2 , except that a forecast which misses by more than a typical reference scores below 0 (Appendix G ). Paired comparisons hold the model and effort setting fixed, and each setting has one run per prompt, so differences between prompt variants are descriptive and not controlled experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 此处，我们提供了第 3.2 节背后的案例，以及两个比较同一任务不同提示变体的欺诈案例。 这些数字来自在低、中、高和超高努力程度（模型与努力的 47 种设置）下完成的 210 项任务的 9,869 次已完成并评分的运行，以及它们所有的运行轨迹。 分数采用表 2 中的 0 到 100 分制，但需要注意的是，若预测值偏离典型参考值超过一定范围，则得分会低于 0（见附录 G）。 配对比较保持模型和努力程度设置不变，且每种设置每个提示仅运行一次，因此不同提示变体之间的差异属于描述性分析，而非受控实验。

paragraphs.en: Table 9 gives 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the overall results of Table 2 , from 10,000 resamples of the 146 task families rather than of the 210 tasks. A family is a base scenario together with its prompt variants, such as the hinted and unhinted versions of a task or the four search widths of the refund-collusion task, so variants of one scenario do not count as independent evidence. Families are named by their task stem, which also merges a few distinct scenarios and so errs toward wider intervals. Clustering widens each side of an interval by at most 1.6 points on the score and 1.9 on the solved rate over resampling tasks. Paired by task, with families resampled, Claude Opus 5.5 leads GPT-6 Astra by 7.7 points [1.4, 13.7], Claude Sonnet 5.5 by 7.7 [2.3, 13.4], and GPT-6.1 Sol by 10.0 [3.6, 16.3], while Astra, Sonnet 5.5, and GPT-6.1 Sol are not separated (Astra leads Sonnet 5.5 by 0.1 [ − - 6.5, 6.6] and GPT-6.1 Sol by 2.3 [ − - 1.2, 6.0], and Sonnet 5.5 leads GPT-6.1 Sol by 2.2 [ − - 4.4, 8.7]). GPT-6.1 Sol leads its predecessor GPT-6 Sol by 12.8 [6.8, 19.1] and Kimi K3 by 21.2 [13.8, 28.5]. Astra leads GPT-6 Sol by 15.1 [9.2, 21.4], Sonnet 5.5 leads GPT-6 Sol by 15.0 [8.9, 21.1], and GPT-6 Sol leads Kimi K3 by 8.4 [0.5, 15.4]. Each setting has one run per task, so the intervals reflect which tasks are in the set and not the variance between runs of the same task.
paragraphs.zh: 表9给出了表2整体结果的95%自助置信区间，该区间基于对146个任务家族的10,000次重采样，而非对210个任务的10,000次重采样。 一个家族包含一个基础场景及其提示变体，例如某个任务的提示暗示版本与无提示暗示版本，或退款共谋任务的四种搜索宽度，因此同一场景的变体并不被视为独立证据。 家族的命名基于其任务主干，这一命名方式也会将一些不同的场景合并在一起，从而导致置信区间偏宽。 聚类使每个区间的两侧最多扩展1.6个分数点和1.9个解决率点（相对于重采样任务而言）。 按任务进行配对，并对家族进行重采样后，Claude Opus 5.5比GPT-6 Astra领先7.7分[1.4, 13.7]，比Claude Sonnet 5.5领先7.7分[2.3, 13.4]，比GPT-6.1 Sol领先10.0分[3.6, 16.3]；而Astra、Sonnet 5.5和GPT-6.1 Sol之间没有明显差异（Astra比Sonnet 5.5领先0.1分[− - 6.5, 6.6]，比GPT-6.1 Sol领先2.3分[− - 1.2, 6.0]；Sonnet 5.5比GPT-6.1 Sol领先2.2分[− - 4.4, 8.7]）。 GPT-6.1 Sol比其前代模型GPT-6 Sol领先12.8分[6.8, 19.1]，比Kimi K3领先21.2分[13.8, 28.5]。 Astra比GPT-6 Sol领先15.1分[9.2, 21.4]，Sonnet 5.5比GPT-6 Sol领先15.0分[8.9, 21.1]，而GPT-6 Sol比Kimi K3领先8.4分[0.5, 15.4]。 每个设置中每个任务仅运行一次，因此这些区间反映了集合中包含哪些任务，而非同一任务不同运行之间的方差。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 gives every model’s mean score at each reasoning effort it offers, on the tasks it completed at every such level. Effort helps the GPT-6 and Claude models at every step, with diminishing returns only for Opus and GPT-6.1 Sol, and the step from high to extra-high adds 1.9 to 11.5 points for them. Kimi K3 gains 10.1 points from low to high and 5.8 more at extra-high, and GLM 5.3 Flash 4.3 from high to extra-high. Past medium, Gemini 3.8 Flash (18.3, 26.9, 26.2) and Qwen 3.8 Max (21.1, 26.3, 24.4) score lower than at medium, Muse Spark 1.3 (16.7, 20.2, 19.7, 20.7) dips at high and recovers at extra-high, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash scores 21.6 at low, 20.5 at high, and 25.4 at extra-high. Each of these drops is under 2 points and within the confidence intervals of Table 9 , so we do not read them as an effect of effort. Two mechanisms are consistent with them. All 65 runs that exhausted the context window are from Qwen 3.8 Max (Appendix F ), whose window is shorter than the other models’, and longer reasoning at higher effort fills it sooner. For the other models, we suspect that runs with many tool calls, each returning data, bury the task’s objective in a long context, and 43 of the 56 runs that reached the turn limit are from Muse Spark 1.3.
paragraphs.zh: 表10给出了每个模型在其提供的每种推理努力水平下，于所有已完成任务上的平均得分。 在每一步中，更高的努力水平都对GPT-6和Claude模型有帮助，但只有Opus和GPT-6.1 Sol的收益会递减；从“高”到“极高”的努力提升能为它们带来1.9至11.5分的增益。 Kimi K3从“低”到“高”的努力提升获得了10.1分，在“极高”时又额外获得5.8分；GLM 5.3和Flash 4.3则分别在高到极高的努力阶段获得了4.3分和5.3分的提升。 超过“中等”努力水平后，Gemini 3.8 Flash（18.3、26.9、26.2）和Qwen 3.8 Max（21.1、26.3、24.4）的得分低于中等水平；Muse Spark 1.3（16.7、20.2、19.7、20.7）在“高”时得分下降，但在“极高”时恢复；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在“低”时为21.6分，“高”时为20.5分，“极高”时为25.4分。 这些分数下降均低于2分，且处于表9的置信区间内，因此我们并不认为这是努力水平的影响。 有两种机制可以解释这些现象。 所有耗尽上下文窗口的65次运行均来自Qwen 3.8 Max（附录F），其上下文窗口比其他模型更短，而更高努力水平下更长的推理过程会更快填满该窗口。 对于其他模型，我们推测包含大量工具调用且每次调用都返回数据的运行会将任务目标淹没在冗长的上下文中；在达到轮次限制的56次运行中，有43次来自Muse Spark 1.3。
